# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Rechecked the pending amendment list against current `tank_tui` HEAD and found the runtime fixes already present: legacy chemistry alias normalization was already wired into snapshot parsing, and the overview screen already labeled the 7-ion TDS/conductivity values as estimates. The remaining gap was coverage, so I extended `crates/tank_tui/src/api_client.rs` with a regression test that proves `/load` responses containing only legacy chemistry field names still deserialize into `TankSnapshot` correctly.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Compared the pending amendment list with the current `tank_tui` snapshot parsing and overview rendering code to determine what still differed from HEAD.
1. [Completed] Confirmed the TUI already normalized legacy chemistry aliases for snapshot deserialization and already labeled overview TDS/conductivity values as estimates, so no additional runtime patch was needed for those paths.
2. [Completed] Extended the `api_client` compatibility tests so the legacy snapshot fixture is reusable by seed and added a `/load` regression proving nested legacy chemistry payloads deserialize successfully.
3. [Completed] Ran targeted formatting and validation for the compatibility and overview paths after the test update.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all -- crates/tank_tui/src/api_client.rs` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_tui api_client::tests --lib` passed (3 tests), covering direct legacy snapshot parsing, canonical-over-legacy precedence, and `/load` nested snapshot compatibility.
- `cargo test -p tank_tui screens::overview::tests::overview_labels_tds_and_conductivity_as_estimates --lib` passed.
- `cargo check -p tank_tui` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- The pending amendment list was stale relative to current HEAD, so this round only added regression coverage rather than changing runtime behavior.
- Validation in this round was targeted to the touched compatibility and overview paths plus `cargo check -p tank_tui`; I did not rerun the full `cargo test -p tank_tui` suite.
- Untracked `.ralph-burning/` workspace artifacts remain in the repository root and were left untouched.
